title: Bounded recursive reachability
statement: For a natural number $K$ and a binary relation $R$ on the natural numbers, define reachability at level $0$ by $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$. At level $i+1$, declare $u$ and $v$ related when there is some $m<K$ such that $u$ is related to $m$ at level $i$ and $m$ is related to $v$ at level $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Binary relation $R$ on the natural numbers
